records.title: Atomic write protocol
records.body: Commit canonical state and its event in one transaction. Roll back both when event insertion fails.

records.title: Effect-time authority validation
records.body: Revalidate authorization immediately before side effects are applied.

records.title: Derived lexical index ownership
records.body: The lexical index is disposable and rebuildable from canonical Knowledge.

records.title: Context Capsule budget accounting
records.body: Account for every caller-visible field except the top-level budget report.

records.title: Safe lexical query normalization
records.body: Tokenize caller punctuation and quote normalized words before constructing MATCH syntax.

records.title: Append-only event history
records.body: Existing knowledge events reject update, delete, and replacement collisions.

records.title: Database write lock
records.body: Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE to serialize database writers safely.

records.title: Transport Layer Security configuration

records.title: Background work queue
records.body: Asynchronous jobs wait in a durable queue until a worker claims them.

records.title: Terreate buffer write contract
